_comment: Editable stemchotic config. The model list + catalogue SDR come live from audio-separator; this file holds the picks/labels/quality tiers and the MVSep-sourced scores for the curated models.
_tiers_comment: Per-category model for each quality tier. Fast = quick/light, Best = top quality (slower). resolve() merges passes that share a model, so on Best the band's drums/bass/guitar/piano/other all come from one RoFormer SW pass. category_defaults is the fallback when a tier omits a category.
_sdr_comment: MVSep multisong leaderboard SDR per stem (mvsep.com/algorithms/77, /3, and the multisong leaderboard). One consistent benchmark, unlike audio-separator's built-in scores. The picker prefers these where present. DrumSep per-piece scores are on a drum-only dataset (different scale) so they are not mixed in here.
_drumsep_sdr_comment: Per-piece SDR on MVSep's drum-only DrumSep dataset (mvsep.com/algorithms/29). A different benchmark from the whole-song MVSep numbers; shown only in the Drum kit target.
_notes_comment: Short 'why' shown next to a model in the picker's right pane. Only the picks worth a sentence; everything else just shows its SDR.

model_notes.BS-Rofo-SW-Fixed.ckpt: Best drums + bass, full band in one pass

_sizes_comment: Download size in MB for the consent prompt (measured via HEAD). Models not listed fall back to a live HEAD request (single files) or 'size unknown' (demucs yaml bundles).
_custom_comment: Public-weight models missing from the UVR catalogue. src/core/registry.py merges them into download_checks.json and downloads the files itself (jarredou's original repos are gone; these are mirrors). 'config' is the LOCAL filename the config is saved as; the SW one must contain 'roformer' or audio-separator loads it with the wrong arch.
_kit_comment: Drum-kit layouts keyed by output piece count. Each maps to a DrumSep model + its output pieces + an optional merge that groups pieces post-split. The jarredou 5-stem model has the better SDR on every shared piece, so it powers 4 and 5 piece; the old 6-stem handles ride/crash splits. The 4-piece sums hh into Cymbals afterward.
